main.description: Register a MEASURED real-world energy-like flow into the kotoba Datom log (:uzu.flow/*), in its NATIVE unit and class. The four classes are incommensurable and are NEVER summed across classes (G2). The experiential class has NO physical/joule conversion — meaning is subject-dependent (G3); the unit MUST be "index" for an experiential flow. Disclosed public aggregates only (:uzu/sourcing :representative); live ingest is Council/operator-gated (G7).

class.description: the unit class — determines the native unit and whether a physical conversion exists

magnitude.description: :uzu.flow/magnitude — value in the native unit (must be > 0)

unit.description: the NATIVE unit; must be W (physical) / USD/yr (economic) / bit/s (informational) / index (experiential) — never normalized away

efficiency.description: physical flows only: useful fraction ∈ 0..1 ⇒ entropy-production (waste-heat) proxy

referenceOnly.description: true if a cross-class visual magnitude was derived (layout only, NOT a unit-identity claim; G4)

txCid.description: kotoba transaction CID (content-addressed append-only Datom log; ADR-2605312345)
